statement: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 with six leaves per inverse and grouped hash-chain early abort: 32 X-groups stop at the first group whose candidates resolve to an x with [x]P = Q (checked). Group work is E-priced by Chen-Stein prefix non-stopping bounds PHI; detection is order-free (each record links to its most recent same-K2-same-d4 predecessor in a cumulative hash table over 2^57 zeroed heads, so cross-group matches need no sorted order); chain walks are charged by KB(129) pair counting with a Janson whole-run overflow row; the worst-case rows run every group with capped walks. certificate.py checks the claim as the least 12-decimal bound at or above log2(E/1000), gives at most 267.7459 per leaf, and the grouped success bound 0.3900000032 clears 0.39; experiment.py replays the kernels and the certificate.
